name: Phoenix Paradise
review:
Phoenix Paradise is a 3x5, 15-line jungle slot following explorer Jeanette. Wilds, wild payline multipliers, mystery wild activation and a walking wild feature drive the action.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 10,000x cap and a 96.13% RTP.

Collecting the three phoenix eggs is the goal, and the walking wild can sweep across several winning lines. Wild payline multipliers boost every line a wild completes.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
